; Calendar Notes sidebar launcher, adapted from rm-appload's AppLoad
; sidebar button:

; Copyright (C) 2026 asivery/rm-appload contributors
; Modifications Copyright (C) 2026 remarkable-calendar-notes contributors

;
; This patch only adds a launcher. The application still runs as the
; external QTFB app installed under AppLoad.
;
; Requires: reMarkable OS 3.27.x, AppLoad >= 0.5.3,
; qt-resource-rebuilder, and a current device-generated hashtab.

AFFECT [[4911547370760691430]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad [[180922.180921]]
    TRAVERSE [[3819512207256720568]] > [[14125623155555875541]]#[[15885405667098360701]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[3819512207256720568]]#[[4073320026945606142]]
        INSERT {
            ~&16385778650434842232&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: calendarNotesSidebar
                ~&8399878573055752961&~: "calendarNotesSidebar"
                ~&214642559243&~: ~&6504222003&~("Calendar Notes")
                ~&8399601734642709923&~: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/appload/remarkable-calendar-notes/icon.png"
                ~&7082453764421&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&233726547792244&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                    AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("external::remarkable-calendar-notes", [], {}, false);
                    ~&233744436321411&~.~&6500896584423236548&~();
                }
                ~&7081629735527&~.preferredHeight: ~&7082020628281&~.~&15061686673205541622&~
                ~&7081629735527&~.~&7797818826744279624&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&214646099849&~
                ~&11921478716705041271&~: ~&233744436321411&~
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
